onboarding.emergency_banner: In a medical emergency? Call 112 / 108 or jump straight to Emergency SOS.
onboarding.step1.title: Emergency Resources & SOS
onboarding.step1.desc: Immediate 24/7 access to national emergency helplines (112, 108) and ambulance requests. Pre-hospital first-aid instructions are accessible offline without needing an account or login.
onboarding.step1.highlight: Urgent care is always open and never blocked by setup.
onboarding.step2.title: Healthcare Facility Search
onboarding.step2.desc: Search and filter local hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and verified doctors with contact numbers and operating hours. Save essential facilities to your browser for quick offline reference.
onboarding.step2.highlight: Search anytime without an account; location permission is completely optional.
onboarding.step3.title: Medication Reminders
onboarding.step3.desc: Manage your daily prescriptions and schedule dosage times right from your personal dashboard. Your schedule is kept privately in your browser storage with timely dose alerts.
onboarding.step3.highlight: Stored locally on your device with no registration needed.
onboarding.step4.title: Cautious Health Support
onboarding.step4.desc: Use our interactive symptom checker for cautious, non-diagnostic guidance and red-flag screening. RELIEF supports English and Bengali, with core guidance available offline.
onboarding.step4.highlight: You can revisit this tour anytime using the Tour button in the navigation.
